ValidationRule.description: Event Start and end date time cant be modified once created
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT(ISNEW()), NOT(IsVRBypassed__c),
NOT( OR( $Profile.Name = "System Administrator", $Profile.Name = "Read Only", $Profile.Name = "Corporate salesforce team" ) ),
OR( ISCHANGED(Start__c), ISCHANGED(End__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Event Start Date and Event End Date cannot be modified after event creation
